company.shortDescription: 7AI provides an AI-driven cybersecurity platform that utilizes AI agents to manage the full lifecycle of security operations.
company.description: 7AI provides an AI-driven cybersecurity platform that uses autonomous “agentic” security agents to manage the full lifecycle of security operations. These AI agents ingest security alerts from tools such as EDR, cloud, and identity systems, enrich and correlate the data, perform end-to-end investigations, and deliver conclusions, thereby reducing alert noise and false positives. With automation extending through detection, investigation, threat hunting, and even authorized response workflows, 7AI allows human security teams to shift focus from repetitive tasks to strategic work. The platform also offers unified incident management, real-time dashboards, and enterprise-insight reporting to contextualize threats and outcomes.
